test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 18 Oct, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

He possesses one of the __slimmer__ handsets in the world.
solution:
The correct answer is '2' i.e. slimmest .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase "**one of the**" is typically followed by a **superlative adjective** and a **plural noun**. 
 
• The adjective 'slim' is a short adjective, and its superlative form is created by adding '-est' (slimmest). The comparative is 'slimmer'. 
 
• The original sentence used the comparative form "slimmer" after "one of the", which is grammatically incorrect in this context. 
 
• Therefore, the superlative form "slimmest" is required to correctly follow "one of the".

Correct sentence: *He possesses one of the **slimmest** handsets in the world*.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__ **

 
• **Degrees of Comparison:** Adjectives have three degrees of comparison: 

 
 
• **Positive:** slim (used when describing a single item or comparing equals, e.g., "This phone is slim.") 
 
• **Comparative:** slimmer (used when comparing two items, e.g., "This phone is slimmer than that one.") 
 
• **Superlative:** slimmest (used when comparing three or more items and indicating the highest degree, e.g., "This is the slimmest phone I've seen.") 
 
 
 
• The construction "one of the" indicates that we are talking about one item from a group of items that all possess the quality to the highest degree. Thus, the superlative is necessary.
